subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a core connected-Control-UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and should related WebChat action surfaces share that contract?
rationale: Current main has partial cron, Web Push, and context-monitoring pieces, but the remaining request changes Control UI product architecture and overlaps other open notification/action work.

options.title: Scope shared notification queue first
options.body: Define one Control UI notification/action contract, then implement cron-finished and context-pressure notifications as focused follow-up work.

options.title: Fold into related action work
options.body: Make the WebChat/Control UI action contract the canonical surface and keep this issue as UX requirements for that broader effort.

options.title: Defer in-app toasts
options.body: Keep current inline cron, Web Push, and context-ring surfaces if maintainers do not want a core toast/snooze layer now.

recommendation.title: Scope shared notification queue first
recommendation.body: Define one Control UI notification/action contract, then implement cron-finished and context-pressure notifications as focused follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried product-review context on this issue and has recent cron notification routing history.
